core_obligations: Reduce to affine lfp V and establish lfp-ness of W
Transfer the property through the etale presentation tower
Apply the lifting lemma and openness of the smooth locus

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to affine lfp V and establish lfp-ness of W

difficulty_reason: Reduces to affine lfp bases via the representability criterion, transfers the (equation-smooth) property along the tower (Sch/W) -> Z -> (Sch/V) by the base-change, smooth-smooth and composition lemmas, then applies the lifting-along-Artinian lemma to conclude W -> V is smooth at every finite type point; the smooth locus is open and finite type points are dense, giving smoothness of W -> V and hence of Z -> V by definition.
